newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina suspends port handler in smuggling probe.
newsitem.headline: Argentina suspends port handler in smuggling probe.

text.p: Argentina's customs service said Thursday it has suspended one of the largest cargo-handling companies in the port of Buenos Aires from operating as a result of a smuggling probe.
Guillermo Murchison, head of Murchison SA, was arrested last week and kept in custody for 24 hours in connection with investigations into containers allegedly imported with false documentation.
A customs service spokeswoman told Reuters it is standard procedure to suspend companies under investigation.
Murchison said Thursday that he only heard his company had been suspended through the media and said his company had broken no law.

"It is true they have told us that some containers with smuggled goods have passed through our depot, but not that there has been any irregularity on our part," he said, quoted by the state-run Telam news agency.

President Carlos Menem announced a crackdown on smuggling earlier in October and appointed an emergency administrator to stamp out corruption within the customs service and merge it with the taxation department.
